nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: SARS-CoV-2 is in the 'Medium' category. All other respiratory viruses we monitor (RSV, Influenza A, Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide. https://t.co/2s0ybhAbic

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/aOwxmgXXpM

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites from the week of June 14th 2025, the LP.8.1 variant in brown (41.7%), NB.1.8.1 in mauve (6.8%), & XFG in orange (18.0%) make up ~67% of variants. Sequencing data has longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/OZsupO8pzj

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 6% and 9% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/y5gjJQUwxx

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 28 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 9 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 6/20/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. The most recent wastewater detection has been in NJ & VA. https://t.co/mer12RcKNg

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 1% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/qUMp9l1O7I

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally because it is not in onset. 36% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/yWGABy50ky

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus is in the ‘Low’ category nationally with low concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/zmXZrPQoTI
